outcome: Congenital ear malformations (Microtia and Atresia of the External Auditory Canal)
Congenital ear deformity children's quality of life
cohort: 975 consecutive children delivered in two public health maternity hospitals in Kazakhstan.
finding: The study revealed significant associations between congenital ear malformation and parental consanguinity, maternal alcohol consumption, maternal medication use, maternal smoking, and stillbirth/prenatal mortality.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was significantly associated with congenital ear malformation and also linked to prenatal complications.
cross-section timing: At the time of or shortly after birth, utilizing hospital records.
